senses.zh_definition: 露西尔；通常用作女性名字的外来人名。
senses.en_definition: Lucille, a traditionally feminine given name of French origin.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang yang lazimnya digunakan sebagai nama perempuan dan berasal daripada bahasa Perancis.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，不是具有普通词义的马来语名词。下列搭配为人名的自然句法组合，不表示有语料频率排名。马来语释义为编辑释义，status 为指定输出标签，不代表已获 DBP 人名认证。英语发音见 [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/pronunciation/english/lucille)，来源见 [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Lucille)。

etymology.historical_story: Lucille entered English through French and belongs to the Latin Lucia name family. Etymological dictionaries describe it as a diminutive associated with Lucia. Its history belongs to European personal naming rather than Malay affixation. When the name occurs in a Malay conversation or document, it still identifies a person rather than acquiring an ordinary Malay dictionary meaning. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Lucille)
